create_fp8_quantization_config: create an Fp8Config quantization config with static or dynamic activation scheme and optional block-wise weight quantization
build_fp8_linear_layer: build a FP8 linear layer method that loads serialized FP8 checkpoints or quantizes BF16/FP16 weights online
quantize_fused_moe_experts: quantize fused MoE expert weights to FP8 with per-tensor or block-wise scaling for w13 and w2 layers
apply_fp8_online_quantization: apply online FP8 quantization to load full-precision checkpoints and quantize weights during loading
setup_fp8_kv_cache_scales: setup FP8 KV-cache scaling factors for attention layers from compressed-tensors checkpoint format
